project_name: ApexTicker - AI Financial Intelligence & Portfolio Dashboard

theme_architecture.color_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL FINANCIAL OBSIDIAN

layout_and_spacing.ticker_tape_style: fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#08090E]/95 border-b border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md py-2 text-xs font-mono overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap shadow-md

key_features_and_components.name: Live Stock Ticker Tape Banner
key_features_and_components.description: Continuous horizontal marquee ticker across the top displaying US & TSX stocks (e.g., AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, SHOP.TO, TD.TO, RY.TO, MSFT, AMZN) with price, change %, and flashing green/red indicators.

key_features_and_components.name: Header & Auth Navigation Bar
key_features_and_components.description: Sticky navigation header containing Brand Logo, Active View Switcher (Portfolio, Watchlist, Movers, AI Analysis, Broker Gateway), Alpha Vantage API Status Indicator, Light/Dark Theme Switcher, User Profile & Email Auth Modal Trigger.

key_features_and_components.name: Portfolio & Investment Tracker
key_features_and_components.description: Displays total portfolio value, total unrealized gain/loss ($ and %), day's change, asset allocation breakdown chart (Recharts pie/donut), holdings data table with search, filter, sparkline mini-charts, and 'Add Holding' dialog.

key_features_and_components.name: Stock Watchlist
key_features_and_components.description: Customizable list of watched US & TSX stocks with real-time price quotes, 52-week range sliders, volume stats, quick remove action, and quick analysis trigger.

key_features_and_components.name: Market Movers Radar (52-Week High & Low + >10% Big Movers)
key_features_and_components.description: Tabbed or grid card section showcasing: 1) Stocks at 52-Week High, 2) Stocks at 52-Week Low, 3) Big Movers (>10% extreme volatility). Includes AI Cause Analysis badges.

key_features_and_components.name: AI Cause Analysis Engine
key_features_and_components.description: AI-powered analysis modal and card drawer explaining root causes for >10% spikes/drops (e.g., Earnings beat, FDA approval, SEC investigation, Macro interest rate shifts, Analyst upgrade/downgrade). Uses structured LLM synthesis.

key_features_and_components.name: Broker & Financial Institution Gateway
key_features_and_components.description: Direct launchpad with high-contrast link-out cards to major Canadian & US brokers/banks (Interactive Brokers, Wealthsimple, Questrade, Charles Schwab, Fidelity, TD WebBroker, RBC Direct Investing, E*TRADE). Includes quick fee & feature badges.

key_features_and_components.name: Stock Detail & Chart Modal/View
key_features_and_components.description: Interactive detailed stock analysis drawer with Recharts candlestick/area price chart, timeframe toggle (1D, 1W, 1M, 1Y, 5Y), key financial ratios (P/E, Market Cap, 52W Range, Vol, Dividend), and company profile.

key_features_and_components.name: Email + Password Authentication
key_features_and_components.description: Auth dialog & drawer supporting Login, Registration, and Session State management with user credentials, saved watchlists, and persistent portfolio storage.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the ticker tape banner runs continuously at the very top or bottom of the screen with explicit data-testid='running-stock-ticker-tape'. Support both US (AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, MSFT) and TSX (SHOP.TO, TD.TO, RY.TO, ENB.TO) symbols.
Implement real Alpha Vantage integration with graceful mock fallback when API limits or keys are exceeded, so the app remains 100% functional and interactive at all times.
Provide AI-powered Cause Analysis for Big Movers (>10% change). The modal/card must clearly outline Catalyst Summary, Market Sentiment Score, Key Metrics, and Analyst Takeaways.
Build the Financial Institution Gateway featuring launch cards for Interactive Brokers, Wealthsimple, Questrade, Schwab, Fidelity, TD, RBC, and BMO with external link icons and security tags.
Use strict typography mapping: Outfit for section titles, JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono for financial values, stock symbols, percentage changes, and prices.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card, and link contains explicit data-testid attributes for reliable end-to-end testing.
Support complete dark and light mode themes via smooth Tailwind CSS dark class toggling.
